summary: WGO is a -40.3% drawdown story driven by genuine cyclical RV/motorhome industry weakness, NOT by undisclosed distress, accounting fraud, or hidden financing problems. The 10-K disclosures are unusually clean and the HONESTY-ALPHA framework finds only ONE moderate under-delivery across 8 verifiable claims: (C7) the company names a 14%-of-COGS supplier without identifying it, leaving readers unable to fully size tariff/supply-chain concentration. EVERYTHING ELSE PASSES: (C1) NO_GOING_CONCERN with $174M cash + $350M unused ABL; (C2) CLEAN_AUDITOR_TENURE with Deloitte for 5+ years (zero 8-K Item 4.01s); (C3) Senior Secured Notes deleveraging is verified across multiple 8-Ks and subsequent 10-Q — $200M of $300M principal redeemed at par in Feb 2025 ($100M) and Feb 2026 ($100M), bringing balance to $100M; (C4) the central 'motorhome transformation' claim is VERIFIED end-to-end — Q1 FY26 Motorhome RV op income flipped to +$8.2M from PY $(3.2)M loss, Q2 to +$7.5M from PY $(0.6)M loss, and dealer field inventory is -19.3% YoY exactly as management said it would be; (C5) ZERO discretionary insider selling in the trailing 12 months despite the drawdown — all 21 NEO sales are code F (RSU vest tax-withholding), insiders are holding through the trough; (C6) the disclosed 51%-from-2-lenders dealer floorplan concentration is reaffirmed consistently in subsequent 10-Qs and the ELEVATED_LIEN_EXPOSURE UCC signal is fully attributable to the pre-existing Senior Secured Notes structure; (C8) NHTSA + EPA FRS confirm real operating manufacturer registrations at the disclosed Indiana/Iowa addresses. Composite 0.125 across 8 claims (7 PASS / 1 MODERATE / 0 SEVERE / 0 RED FLAG / 0 UNVERIFIABLE). The honesty profile is the opposite of a distress short — this is a cyclical recovery candidate with management actively deleveraging through the trough.
